title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Public Security on Issuing the Opinions on Carrying Out the Work of Resolving Social Conflicts in Judicial Detention
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Public Security

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Resolving Social Conflicts during Judicial Detention

Fa Fa [2016] No. 25

Higher People's Courts and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps Public Security Bureau:

In order to further standardize and deepen the work of resolving social conflicts in detention centers under public security organs, to better leverage the functional advantages of detention centers in ensuring the smooth progress of judicial proceedings and maintaining social harmony and stability, to deepen the joint enforcement mechanism, and to make concerted efforts to solve the difficulty in enforcing judgments and rulings of people's courts, the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Public Security, on the basis of summarizing and absorbing the successful experiences and practices of some local people's courts and public security organs in carrying out the working mechanism for resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, have decided to establish a nationwide cooperation mechanism between people's courts and public security organs to jointly promote the resolution of social conflicts during judicial detention. The Opinions of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Public Security on Carrying out the Work of Resolving Social Conflicts during Judicial Detention are hereby issued to you. Please implement them conscientiously in light of the actual circumstances.

November 16, 2016

Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Resolving Social Conflicts during Judicial Detention

Judicial detention is a compulsory measure taken by a people's court, in accordance with the law, against a person who obstructs litigation or enforcement. It plays an important role in maintaining judicial order, building a social credit system, and promoting the resolution of enforcement difficulties. Comprehensively carrying out the work of resolving social conflicts for persons under judicial detention is an important part of the social mediation system. It is the political, legal, and social responsibility jointly shouldered by people's courts and public security organs. It is an important measure to solve enforcement difficulties, and an innovative move to improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, strengthen and innovate social governance, and deepen the construction of a Peaceful China. To comprehensively standardize the methods and procedures for people's courts and public security organs to carry out the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, the following opinions are hereby put forward:

I. Guiding Ideology and Basic Principles

(A) Guiding Ideology

Fully implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third, Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee, proactively adapt to the new normal of economic development and the new situation of political and legal work, strictly implement the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on Detention Centers, adhere to the principle of combining punishment with education. People's courts and public security organs shall closely cooperate and coordinate with each other, give full play to their respective functional advantages, jointly explore scientific methods and effective paths for resolving litigation-related disputes under the new situation, establish and improve an organic, coordinated, efficient and convenient dispute resolution mechanism, maximize the resolution of disputes involved by persons under judicial detention, promptly eliminate disharmonious factors, ensure the legal effect and social effect of judicial detention measures and the management and education work of detention centers, and make due contributions to solving enforcement difficulties and building a Peaceful China.

(B) Basic Principles

- Detain according to law, admit detention promptly. Where a people's court, based on the nature and specific circumstances of the illegal act of a person obstructing litigation or enforcement, deems it truly necessary to take judicial detention measures, it shall promptly make a detention decision and deliver the person under judicial detention to the designated detention center for execution. The detention center shall promptly admit persons under judicial detention who meet the conditions for detention, and shall not delay or refuse without cause.

- Manage according to law, connect organically. The detention center shall carry out management and education work in accordance with the law, take eliminating confrontation, submitting to discipline, and ensuring safety as the prerequisite, take resolving conflicts and disputes as the goal, actively carry out education and resolution work, do its best, and focus on effectiveness. People's courts and public security organs shall do a good job of connecting at every stage of judicial detention to ensure the smooth and orderly development of judicial detention work.

- Communicate with each other, cooperate synergistically. When people's courts and public security organs carry out the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, they shall perform their duties according to law, communicate with each other, fulfill their respective responsibilities, cooperate synergistically, strengthen implementation, complement each other's advantages, and pay attention to details.

- Safeguard rights and interests, be fair and just. When people's courts and public security organs carry out the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, they shall adhere to the principles of voluntariness, openness, fairness, and justice. They shall protect the legitimate rights and interests of the parties and protect the personal privacy of the parties.

- Supervise performance, conclude the case. For those who have been subjected to judicial detention measures for refusing to perform obligations determined in effective legal documents, during the process of resolving conflicts, people's courts and public security organs shall carry out persuasion, education, and conflict resolution work based on the principle of realizing the rights and interests of creditors, and supervise the persons under judicial detention to perform relevant obligations according to law, truly achieving the conclusion of the case.

II. Working Mechanism

(C) Collaborative Linkage Mechanism

Higher People's Courts and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall establish and improve collaborative linkage mechanisms for the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, and guide the courts and public security organs at the city, county, and district levels within their jurisdictions to establish collaborative linkage mechanisms as soon as possible. People's courts and public security organs shall each designate specific persons responsible for the issue of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, communicate regularly with each other, exchange information, and form a consensus.

(D) Joint Meeting Mechanism

People's courts and public security organs shall hold joint meetings regularly or irregularly to report on the progress of the admission, management, education, and social conflict resolution work for persons under judicial detention, discuss and study existing problems, and jointly carry out professional training, experience exchange, and summarization work.

(E) Information Sharing Mechanism

People's courts and public security organs shall continuously promote information technology construction, use information technology means to establish "point-to-point" dedicated lines as information network channels for carrying out the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, and realize information sharing on basic information, case details, etc., of persons under judicial detention. Gradually realize remote video conversations and meetings, so that court staff, detention center staff, persons under judicial detention, and their family members can conduct remote video dialogues to carry out psychological counseling and conflict resolution.

(F) Dynamic Feedback Mechanism

The detention center shall promptly feedback to the people's court the daily performance, recognition of mistakes and repentance, willingness to perform, progress of conflict resolution work, etc., of the person under judicial detention. Before the expiry of the detention period, if the people's court considers it necessary to release the person from judicial detention early, it shall promptly notify the detention center and handle the relevant release procedures.

(G) Emergency Support Mechanism

People's courts and public security organs shall formulate emergency plans for persons under judicial detention. If an emergency occurs during the detention period, the emergency handling mechanism shall be activated promptly, arrangements shall be made properly, and resolution shall be achieved quickly to ensure safety.

III. Resolution Procedures

(H) Full-process Resolution

For persons who meet the conditions for taking judicial detention measures, during the process of handling the detention procedures, the case handler shall do a good job of persuading and educating the person under judicial detention and resolving conflicts, striving for the person to recognize mistakes, repent, and proactively perform relevant obligations. Public security organs shall set up conflict resolution studios and psychological counseling rooms within detention centers, establish accounts for conflict resolution of persons under judicial detention, keep full records of the entire conflict resolution process, and form complete conflict resolution files. People's courts and public security organs shall record the conflict resolution situation in interview transcripts or keep audio or video materials.

(I) Detention Connection

Detention centers shall simplify judicial detention procedures and improve admission efficiency. For persons against whom the people's court has decided to take detention measures, quickly handle the admission procedures according to law to ensure smooth connection work. Detention centers shall establish a green channel for physical examinations of persons under judicial detention with relevant hospitals. If a detention center finds that an admitted person suffers from a serious illness or other circumstances unsuitable for detention, it shall promptly suggest that the people's court stop execution of the detention, and the people's court shall immediately handle the matter and reply to the detention center.

(J) Case Connection

When the people's court delivers a person for judicial detention, the delivering personnel shall inform the detention center of the cause of action of the case involving the person under judicial detention, the focus and key points of the dispute, and provide relevant case materials, contact information of the case handler and the family members of the person under judicial detention. The detention center shall promptly understand the situation of the dispute, clarify the responsible person and participants for conflict resolution according to the standard requirements for conflict resolution work, and formulate specific implementation plans for conflict resolution.

(K) Education and Guidance

After admission, the supervisory police officer of the detention center shall conduct the first interview education with the person under judicial detention within twenty-four hours, seizing the golden time and best opportunity for conflict resolution. It is necessary to patiently explain the law, proceed step by step, appeal to reason and emotion, adopt different strategies for different cases, and provide education tailored to individual persons, carrying out various forms of educational guidance and emotional care. During the detention period, the people's court shall assign staff to go to the detention center or conduct interviews via video link with the person under judicial detention to understand their ideological dynamics and willingness to perform, carry out persuasion, education, and guidance work, and strive for early resolution of disputes.

(L) Classified Resolution

Detention centers shall implement graded and classified resolution based on the nature, impact, degree of harm, and difficulty of resolution of the disputes involving the person under judicial detention, and assign specific responsible persons. For disputes where the person under judicial detention shows signs of repentance and the resolution is relatively easy, the supervisory police officer may be solely responsible; for major and difficult disputes, after consultation with the people's court, the head of the people's court or the detention center may take the lead, with the supervisory police officer implementing specifically. When necessary, the detention center may introduce social resources and professional institutions to carry out guidance and education work for persons under judicial detention. The people's court may designate experienced judges to cooperate with the detention center to carry out psychological guidance work specifically for persons under judicial detention.

(M) Follow-up Return Visits

For persons who have reached a settlement agreement and been released from judicial detention, the people's court may assign personnel to conduct follow-up return visits to consolidate the results of conflict resolution and supervise the person to perform obligations on time. If the participation of detention center staff is required, the detention center shall actively cooperate and assign the police officers who participated in the conflict resolution to participate in the return visit.

IV. Work Requirements

(N) Raise Awareness, Strengthen Leadership

People's courts and public security organs at all levels shall fully understand the important significance of carrying out the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, firmly establish a sense of overall situation, enhance the sense of responsibility for the work, effectively strengthen leadership, carefully organize, conscientiously perform duties, closely cooperate, actively build a linkage mechanism for resolving social conflicts during judicial detention, and jointly shoulder the political and social responsibilities of ensuring the safety of detention centers, resolving social conflicts, solving court enforcement difficulties, and promoting harmony and stability.

(O) Improve Mechanisms, Standardize Operations

People's courts and public security organs shall strengthen institutional construction, improve the approval procedures for detention measures against persons under judicial detention, formulate operational standards for carrying out conflict resolution work for persons under judicial detention, and continuously summarize and improve in practice, gradually establishing a long-term mechanism for resolving social conflicts during judicial detention.

(P) Clarify Responsibilities, Strengthen Guarantees

People's courts and public security organs at all levels shall implement the leadership responsibility system and incorporate the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention into performance appraisals. Strengthen the construction of conflict resolution teams, and strengthen theoretical study and professional training on conflict resolution work. People's courts and public security organs shall provide necessary support and guarantees for the funds required by detention centers to carry out the work of resolving social conflicts during judicial detention.

(Q) Summarize Experience, Promote Best Practices

People's courts and public security organs shall regularly evaluate the effectiveness of conflict resolution work, continuously improve and enhance the ability and level of conflict resolution work, cultivate and discover advanced models, commend and reward units and individuals with outstanding achievements, promptly summarize and promote good experiences and practices, increase external publicity, and establish a good image.
